cleavage agent: Tryptic digestion was performed for 3 h with 0.1 μg trypsin (Promega Sequencing Grade; Madison, WI) per sample.
enrichment method: resulting in a nuclear pellet ready for acid histone extraction.
fragmentation method: with both collision induced dissociation (CID) and high energy collision dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
instrument: analyzed using a LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spec-trometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
ionization type: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ionization mode using a data dependent acquisition method.
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: All buffers were supplemented with spermidine (1:1000), beta-mercaptoethanol (1:1000)
